1879060952.name: Riddle
1879060952.desc: Daze the enemy briefly, waking the foe when damage is dealt.\n\nUsing this skill will not break Stealth.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879064152.name: In Harm's Way
1879064152.desc: You put yourself in harm's way to defend your nearby companions, taking half of all damage dealt to them upon yourself.

1879073752.name: Savage Fangs
1879073752.desc:
You rip at your target's flesh, tearing muscle and slowing his attacks. If the target was suffering from your crippling bite he begins taking damage over time. <rgb=#FF7700> 
 
 In Flayer: Brutal Fangs 
 Reduces Evade rating. 
 Brute bonus: Reduces armour rating. 
 
 In Shadow: Shadow Fangs 
 Increases induction time and reduces parry rating.   </rgb>

1879109976.name: Brutal Assault
1879109976.desc: You use brute strength to hammer home a well placed blow. If a deep wound is present on the target, Brutal Assault will add a brutal wound.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Opens combat and parry responses.</rgb>

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.

1879218264.name: Imp. Quick Shot: Elvish Arrow
1879218264.desc:
Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

Has a chance to generate additional Focus.

Arrows inflict Light damage.

1879230296.name: Bestial Claws
1879230296.desc:
As a shadow, your swift movements conceal the bestial nature of your claws.
Bonus critical chance.

   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879238616.name: Invigourate
1879238616.desc: You nurture your steed back to a battle-ready state, restoring its power over a short period of time.

1879243992.name: Rally the Riders
1879243992.desc: You issue a fearsome call to arms that negatively affects enemies surrounding you while bolstering allies around you.

1879244376.name: Explosive Arrow
1879244376.desc: You fire an explosive tipped arrow at your target that will detonate shortly after impact.

1879302616.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Shield-maiden)
1879302616.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879315032.name: Expose (Man)
1879315032.desc: Seeing a weakness in the enemy's defences, you exploit it, increasing your target's vulnerability to damage.\n\nMakes targets more vulnerable to Tactical damage in Man form.

1879316056.name: Recuperate
1879316056.desc: Catch your breath and recuperate. Restores Morale and places a heal over time on the Beorning.

1879334744.name: Arrow of Righteousness
1879334744.desc: These arrows will make servants of the Eye burn, fearing as they do the goodness of the Dúnedain.

1879339352.name: Leaf-fall Kite
1879339352.desc: Brings out a leaf-fall kite for you to fly!

1879341912.name: Ranged Fierce Resolve
1879341912.desc: Drains morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879360856.name: Banded Snake
1879360856.desc: Brings out a banded snake to keep you company.

1879412824.name: Soot-feathered Crow
1879412824.desc: Summons a companion of the Autumn Sage.

1879422296.name: Fist of the Valar
1879422296.desc:
Strike your foe with preternatural force.

This skill consumes all your Mettle, but deals 15% bonus damage for each point of Mettle it consumes.
This bonus damage stacks with Battle Flow.

1879447384.name: Library Corgi
1879447384.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879466328.name: Whirling Breach
1879466328.desc: A whirling attack that opens enemies to a greater attack\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Opens a combat response.</rgb>

1879468376.name: Ferocious Roar
1879468376.desc: Let out a battle cry, causing you to rapidly gain Wrath.

conditionalEffects.description: After using Ferocious Roar, your next attack will critically hit.

1879488728.name: Call to Lurkers
1879488728.desc: Beseech a wild Bog-lurker to aid you.

1879506648.name: Prepared: Shadow-spike
1879506648.desc: Send a shadowy spike at your target, dealing damage and reducing their tactical prowess.

1879508184.name: Shard of Reality
1879508184.desc: Use the Shard of Reality to lock your Madness to its current level for 60 seconds.

1879509336.name: Cunning Attack
1879509336.desc: Deals damage even after the initial strike.\n\nThe bleed deals more damage while Stealthed.

1879516760.name: Drop Red Mushroom
1879516760.desc: Drop your current mushroom.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>
